mapper.sql: SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.academic_year, student.username AS student_username, student.name AS student_name, teacher.username AS teacher_username, teacher.name AS teacher_name, l.id AS lesson_id, l.title AS lesson_title, l.scheduled_at, t.id AS task_id, t.title AS task_title, t.description FROM tasks t JOIN lessons l ON l.id = t.lesson_id JOIN courses c ON c.id = l.course_id JOIN users student ON student.id = c.student_id JOIN users teacher ON teacher.id = c.teacher_id LEFT JOIN solutions s ON s.task_id = t.id
mapper.select: WHERE c.student_id = #{studentId} AND s.id IS NULL ORDER BY l.scheduled_at, t.id
